title: One Patch, Three Roles: What Is Actually Coupled in Autoregressive Time-Series Forecasting?
abstract: arXiv:2609.23686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Patch-based autoregressive time-series forecasting often ties input representation, learned transitions, and recursive execution to one patch length. We ask which of these roles can be adjusted separately. A supporting atomic-encoding study finds greater sensitivity to model width than to atom grouping on the evaluated grid. Our main finding is that a frozen parent's recursive trajectory is easier to fit than the observed future with lightweight parallel exits. Autoregressive Trajectory Distillation (ATD) turns this into selectable ATD-1/2/4/8 execution, with ATD-1 exactly recovering the parent. On a paired four-data-set comparison, ATD-8 reaches $5.54\times$ end-to-end speedup with stable quality across widths. Fewer calls do not automatically remove the parent's existing forecast error: ATD improves trajectory fidelity in all 21 seed runs but forecast accuracy in only 15 against matched clean-future supervision. translated_title: 一个补丁，三种角色：自回归时间序列预测中究竟什么被耦合在一起？
translated_abstract: 基于补丁的自回归时间序列预测通常将输入表示、学习到的转移以及递归执行这三个角色绑定在同一个补丁长度上。我们探究这些角色中哪些可以被独立调整。一项支持性的原子编码研究发现，在所评估的参数网格上，模型对模型宽度的敏感性大于对原子分组的敏感性。我们的主要发现是：冻结父模型的递归轨迹比观测到的未来序列更容易用轻量级并行出口来拟合。自回归轨迹蒸馏将这一发现转化为可选的 ATD-1/2/4/8 执行模式，其中 ATD-1 能够精确恢复父模型。在配对的四数据集比较中，ATD-8 实现了 5.54 倍的端到端加速，且在不同模型宽度下质量保持稳定。更少的调用并不会自动消除父模型已有的预测误差：ATD 在全部 21 个种子运行中都提升了轨迹保真度，但相对于匹配的干净未来监督，仅在 15 个运行中提升了预测精度。我们进一步发现一个相关……
tldr: 该论文提出自回归轨迹蒸馏（ATD），发现冻结父模型的递归轨迹比观测未来更易拟合，据此用轻量级并行出口实现可选加速执行（ATD-8 达 5.54 倍端到端加速且质量稳定），但同时指出更少的调用并不能自动消除父模型固有的预测误差。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Autoregressive Trajectory Distillation (ATD), showing that a frozen parent's recursive trajectory is easier to fit than the observed future, enabling lightweight parallel exits with selectable speedups (ATD-8 achieves 5.54× end-to-end speedup with stable quality), while noting that fewer calls do not automatically remove the parent's inherent forecast error.
